summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc, a Jersey-incorporated gold producer listed on NYSE American, AIM and VFEX, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing receipt of a TR-1 major-holdings notification from BlackRock, Inc. BlackRock crossed an AIM notification threshold on 13 October 2026, moving from 5.03% direct voting rights to 4.92%, with financial instruments cutting total holdings from 6.96% to 6.15% (1,190,050 voting rights), including 160,300 lent shares and 76,826 cash-settled CFDs. Caledonia itself is the passive issuer; no board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch BlackRock's residual overhang and whether disposals continue.
